baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative opens an imagined change of state, and the two material predicates form an escalation from hard stone to the resistant hardness of iron.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and coming-to-be make the imperative a demand to occupy an imagined state.
Hard stone supplies the first compact and resistant material state.
Iron and its resistant hardness intensify the second material state.

changed_reading.before: The line merely names two hard substances.
changed_reading.after: The line challenges the hearers to occupy whatever maximally resistant material state they can imagine.

baseline_models.mechanism: The alternatives overlap as technologies of refusal: stone encloses and blocks, while the semantic field of iron supplies limits, barriers, and prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and enclosure turn stone from passive matter into a blocking function.
The distinguishing boundary makes iron a figure for a terminal limit.
Prevention and prohibition give that limit an active excluding force.

changed_reading.before: Stone and iron are examples of physical hardness.
changed_reading.after: Stone and iron also figure the hearers' strongest imaginable strategy of becoming a barrier.

baseline_models.mechanism: The disjunction need not be a simple hardness scale: stone resists as compact mass, whereas iron can resist or act through a sharpened, penetrating edge.

activation_trace.role: The hard stone image supplies dense, blunt mass.
The sharp penetrating edge supplies an active alternative to stone's blunt resistance.

changed_reading.before: Iron simply repeats stone at a higher degree of hardness.
changed_reading.after: The two predicates offer different material functions: immovable mass or penetrating edge.

baseline_models.mechanism: An instruction to utter is immediately followed by an imperative of becoming, compressing reported speech and imagined ontological change into one sequence.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance launches the quoted challenge.
Coming-to-be makes material identity the immediate object of that utterance.

changed_reading.before: The speaker reports a pair of hypothetical materials.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself stages the hearers crossing into the material states they imagine.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier claim that every thing praises while the hearers fail to understand removes the easy equation of stone or iron with mute, unreachable matter. Materiality may exceed human comprehension without ceasing to be responsive.

activation_trace.role: Hard stone supplies one named material member of the wider class of things.
Iron supplies the second named material member of that class.
Repeated worshipful praise gives things a meaningful activity rather than inert silence.
The generic knowable thing supplies the class under which the two materials can be included.
Failure of understanding locates the opacity in the hearer rather than necessarily in matter.

structural_cues: 17:44 places universal praise and failed human comprehension before the material imperative at 17:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every thing praising, hearers not understanding, and stone and iron as named things; I infer class inclusion, while the live alternative is that the universal statement does not specify how material praise bears on restoration.

changed_reading.before: Becoming stone or iron would mean retreating into inert matter.
changed_reading.after: Even the proposed material refuge remains within an addressable and meaningful order that human listeners may simply fail to comprehend.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed barrier, coverings over hearts, weight in ears, and loss of a path turn the material imperative into an externalization of an already enacted receptive posture: the hearers have been making themselves inaccessible before being told to imagine stone or iron.

activation_trace.role: Stone's prevention and enclosure condense the preceding barriers into a material state.
Iron's preventing and prohibiting field intensifies that self-fortification.
A covering barrier supplies the first spatial layer of inaccessible reception.
Protective covering moves the barrier inward onto the heart.
Weight in the ear makes blocked hearing materially heavy.
The extended traversable path, now unavailable, shows the functional result of the barriers.

structural_cues: 17:45-48 progresses from an intervening veil to covered hearts, weighted ears, turning away, and inability to find a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barrier sequence and focus branches of enclosure and prevention; I infer that the command materializes the hearers' receptive stance, while the alternative is that the barrier sequence and hard materials are parallel but independent figures.

changed_reading.before: Stone and iron are arbitrary examples of harder matter.
changed_reading.after: Stone and iron expose as bodily matter the blocking behavior already performed in hearing, understanding, and turning away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding question moves from hard bone to pulverized remains and asks about renewed creation; the focus answers by reversing the material direction toward stone and iron. Disintegration and maximal cohesion become opposite points on one spectrum, neither of which blocks reactivation.

activation_trace.role: Hard stone supplies a high-cohesion answer to the preceding image of remains.
Resistant iron pushes the high-cohesion pole still further.
Hard bone supplies the residual bodily substrate from which the objection begins.
Pulverization and debris supply the low-cohesion extreme.
Stirring what is still from rest supplies the reactivation that crosses the material spectrum.
Creative bringing-into-being makes reconstitution the disputed operation.
New occurrence after cutting links fragmentation to renewed creation rather than final loss.

structural_cues: 17:49's question runs directly into the imperative and disjunction of 17:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pulverized remains, reactivation, new creation, and two highly cohesive materials; I supply the directional axis from disintegration to cohesion, while the live alternative is a simpler rhetorical escalation in hardness without a full material spectrum.

changed_reading.before: The answer merely says that even harder material could be raised.
changed_reading.after: The answer reverses the objection: whether identity is dispersed into debris or consolidated into resistant matter, material condition does not govern the possibility of renewed creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following disjunction extends stone and iron into any created form imagined as greater, then answers the return question with first origination. The focus list is therefore deliberately non-exhaustive, and agency shifts from the resistance of the form to the one who first opened it into existence.

activation_trace.role: Coming-to-be keeps the hypothetical state open beyond the two named predicates.
Stone is the first concrete member of the expandable created-form list.
Iron is the second concrete member rather than the terminal possible form.
Created being generalizes the material predicates into an open class of forms.
What is magnified in the chest marks the limiting form as hearer-imagined rather than objectively fixed.
Return after departure shifts the issue from substance to restored identity.
Origination supplies the agentive precedent for return.
Firstness fixes origination as prior to every later material state.

structural_cues: 17:51 begins with another أَوْ, syntactically continuing the alternatives of 17:50 before asking who will return the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continued disjunction, an unrestricted created form, return, and first origination; I infer that the list concedes any imagined resistant ontology, while the alternative is that the third member functions only as hyperbolic emphasis.

changed_reading.before: Stone and iron are the two decisive test cases.
changed_reading.after: They are only the opening cases in an unrestricted concession: no self-imagined created form outruns the agency already demonstrated in first origination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sequence of utterance and becoming is followed by a day when the hearers are called and answer. Restoration is rendered as addressable response across a stay they retrospectively judge brief, not as matter autonomously rebuilding itself.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech launches the focus command and supplies the first side of an address-response pattern.
Coming-to-be links the address to the state whose restoration is at issue.
Vocal summons supplies the initiating act that reaches the addressees.
Answering speech supplies the hearers' responsive return.
The interval of remaining in a state makes the material condition temporally bounded.

structural_cues: 17:52 follows the identification of the first Originator and retains second-person plural address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, summons, answer, and a bounded interval; I infer that the focus imperative anticipates the later call-and-response mechanism, while the alternative is that the two speech scenes are only adjacent rhetorical forms.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks the hearers to imagine a different substance.
changed_reading.after: The imperative foreshadows that any such material state remains vocatively reachable and can be crossed by summons and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to have the servants say what is best, set against verbal provocation, constrains the tone of the focus challenge. Its severe material imagery functions as an argued reply, not as permission to turn the addressees into contemptible objects.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance marks the challenge as an instructed speech act.
Speech as engagement in a matter frames the repeated say-and-say construction as disciplined dialogue.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the qualitative constraint on the reply.
A verbal jab supplies the rejected alternative use of sharp speech.

structural_cues: 17:53 repeats an imperative of saying followed by subordinate saying, closely echoing the speech frame of 17:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies instructed speech, the best utterance, and verbal provocation; I infer that this norm governs the nearby focus reply, while the live alternative is that 17:53 addresses a separate social setting without retroactively qualifying 17:50.

changed_reading.before: Be stone or iron can sound like an unbounded insult.
changed_reading.after: The hard image remains polemically forceful but is contained as a reasoned, instructed answer within a demand for better speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus imperative can superficially sound as if the hearers may choose an unreturnable state. The later denial that invoked powers own removal or transformation, followed by complete encompassing of people, shifts the command into a concession: imagine any self-enclosure, but control over changing and containing states lies elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Coming-to-be supplies the apparent self-directed change of state that context will reassign.
Stone's enclosure supplies the imagined defensive state.
Iron's prevention supplies the stronger imagined exclusion.
Ownership and disposal identify the capacity explicitly denied to the invoked powers.
Removal of a covering supplies one unavailable operation on an imposed condition.
Transformation from one state to another names the second unavailable operation.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and securing places every human self-enclosure inside a larger reach.

structural_cues: 17:56 denies ownership of removing harm or transforming it; 17:60 closes the window with the Lord encompassing people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an imperative of state, denied ownership of removal and transformation, and complete encompassing; I infer that the imperative concedes imagined form without conceding agency, while the alternative is that 17:56 concerns only false objects of invocation and does not specify the 17:50 transformation.

changed_reading.before: The hearers are challenged to choose a substance beyond restoration.
changed_reading.after: They are conceded any imagined defensive state, but neither the state nor its occupants own the transformation or escape the larger encompassing agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the smooth stone branch is distant from the selecting sense active in 17:40. It remains anchored because that branch literally supplies a stone image and the focus explicitly names stone; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material texture, not as the asserted sense of أَصْفَىٰ.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies literal hard stone as the receiving material image.
A smooth stone cleared of soil or clay adds stripping and purification to the focus material.

changed_reading.after: Stone can momentarily carry an imagined stripping of admixture into a smoother, supposedly less vulnerable substrate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the metallurgical branch of testing in 17:60 to iron named ten verses earlier. It remains tightly anchored in literal iron and in a branch that explicitly tests both metal and person; downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-domain activation rather than claim an explicit furnace scene.

activation_trace.role: Literal resistant iron supplies material capable of being assayed.
Testing metal and person turns the hardest proposed identity into test material rather than an escape from testing.

changed_reading.before: Iron is the imagined endpoint of resistance.
changed_reading.after: Becoming iron may place the hearer more vividly under assay: the resistant substrate is precisely what a test can disclose.

strongest_changes: 17:49-51 turns stone and iron into the cohesive middle of a spectrum running from pulverized remains to any imagined created form, all governed by return to first origination.
17:44 prevents stone and iron from functioning as mute escape categories because every thing praises even where human comprehension fails.
17:45-48 makes the materials externalize barriers already enacted in hearing, understanding, and pathfinding.
17:52 recasts restoration as summons and response across a bounded material interval.
summary.what_was_special: The focus materials remained concrete while acquiring several distinct functions: resistant substrate, self-fortification, addressable matter, and material under assay. The context changed the locus of power from what a body can become to what can originate, call, return, transform, and encompass it.
remaining_uncertainties: The inclusion of stone and iron under every praising thing is structurally strong but does not specify the mode of material responsiveness.
The mapping from veiled reception to stone and iron may be deliberate mechanism or a close thematic parallel.
The metallurgical testing branch of ف ت ن is exceptionally apt for iron but remains an exploratory lexical activation.
The imperative may function as pure rhetorical concession rather than as a foreshadowing of the later summons.
